lostOrCollapsedStructure.result: Rows and cells become ordinary paragraphs; coordinates and column membership are discarded.
Heading evidence is reduced to text regex plus coarse maximum size/bold flags.
Original block, line, span, page, and coordinate provenance is absent from DOCX paragraphs.
Markers remain literal text; list identity, nesting, and continuation are not represented.
Initially flattened into body paragraphs and reconstructed later through text-pattern matching.
An empty page-break paragraph survives in raw DOCX but page provenance is not attached to content nodes.
Columns are linearized; column identity and region boundaries are discarded.
Per-span font identity, size, weight, italic, color, baseline, and character boxes collapse to max size plus any-bold/any-italic.
Order is retained only implicitly as paragraph order, without evidence or confidence.

conclusions.qualification: Lines inside one PDF text block are merged when vertical distance and x alignment satisfy _same_paragraph. Wrapping can still fragment when the PDF producer emits separate blocks, indentation changes, a column/table boundary intervenes, or _can_continue rejects an uppercase, numeric, or punctuation-led continuation.
